spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation : The Three Archetypes

** ¶1:** There is a thre efold mode of divine proceeding that is app rehended, however dim ly, even by the natural mind. People name it out wardly without interior understanding: they call it * divine good *, *full ness of truth*, and *minist ering affection *. But what are these in themselves? What is divine good in its origin ? What is the fullness of truth in its deriv ation? What is minist ering affection in its operation ? What are these three universal principles ?

**¶3:** These three principles exist etern ally in the kingdom of divine wisdom, and they are infinite — no finite compreh ension can contain them.

**¶4:** What are called *divine goods* are those things which proceed directly from the Divine Love itself. They are formed according to the infinite pattern of that Love's own nature .

**¶5:** What are called *full nesses of truth* are the deriv ations of those first divine goods; for when the Divine Love brought forth goods from itself, those goods in turn brought forth tru ths corresponding to themselves . These deriv ations are the abundance of spiritual knowledge .

**¶6:** Those full nesses of truth, in their turn, brought forth from themselves active ministering affections. These are the three universal principles that exist within the kingdom of divine wisdom. They are without limit or measure.

**¶7:** Now hear this in another degree . Those who are called *divine goods* in a second sense are the emanations that have gone forth from the Divine Love into the created order — the powers of good that the Divine sent out into spiritual combat, and which overc ame all that is hostile to life and order .

**¶8:** And the *fullnesses of truth* in this second sense are the deriv ations of those first living divine tru ths proce eding from good . These spiritual truths have come forth and accomplished and fulfilled the purposes of Divine Providence, in the interior states and in the exterior states alike .

**¶9:** And those called *minist ering affections* in this second sense are the active powers derived from the fullnesses of truth, which themselves proceeded from the three living divine tru ths. They have been sent as messengers and medi ators into the structure of the regenerating mind. They reach even into the divine good that lies impl anted in the inmost soul — that good which ab ides in still ness and conce alment, not yet perceived by the conscious understanding . And further , they reach all the human affections that have become entangled and held captive by evil and falsity. To those capt ive affections they bring the begin nings of faith and of trust gr ounded in charity.

**¶ 10:** Again: * divine goods*, in a third sense, are all those goods that belong to the celest ial kingdom, which is governed by the in most love itself .

**¶11:** And * minist ering affections*, in a third sense , are all those active tru ths that belong to the spiritual kingdom, governed by the principle of wisdom proce eding from love .

**¶12:** And *fullnesses of truth*, in a third sense, are all those kn owledges of good and truth that belong to the natural- spiritual kingdom, governed by the medi ating principle — that function which represents and communic ates the interior divine to the exterior world .

---

*A note on the structure : * The text presents three discrete degrees of the same three principles — first as they exist infin itely in the Divine itself , then as they proceed into spiritual combat and redem pt ive operation , and finally as they are organized into three kingdoms or heav ens. This maps precisely to what Swedenborg calls the celest ial, spiritual, and natural degrees of the one Divine infl ux. The rever sal of order in ¶10 – 12 ( where "angels " are placed under the spiritual principle and "rich ones" under the medi ating principle) suggests the text recogn izes that the arrangement of these principles * shifts * according to the governing love of each kingdom — a teaching fully conson ant with the doctrine of discrete degrees.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are these three archetypes [in the land of light, and there is no measure to] them!
So, the ones who are called 'god', are the gods whom the Father has summoned from himself. He has established them after the likeness of his greatness.

Conversely, these who are named 'rich [ones]', are the evocations of the first rich gods of the Father; because, when the Father had summoned (the first), they themselves summoned evocations. They called them 'rich'.
They too, the rich ones, have summoned their evocations. They call them 'angel'. These are the three archetypes who occur in the land of light. There is no measure to apply to them!

Once again, listen! Other persons who are named 'god' are the emanations who have come from the Father; the evocations of the Father whom he summoned forth. They came out to the contest and humiliated the enmity.

Conversely, the 'rich ones' are the evocations of these first living words. They too, the rich ones, have come and performed and fulfilled the pleasure of the greatness, in the worlds that are above and below.

On the other hand, the ones who are named the 'angels' are the evocations of the rich ones, who had come from the three living words. They have been sent in an embassy and an apostolate to this building. They have come to the entire divinity, which is established in silence and in hiddenness. And, also, they have come to all the souls who have been entangled in the enemy. They have brought them hope and confidence.
Again, they are called 'god', all the gods who belong to the household of the Great Spirit.
Conversely, the ones who are called 'angel', are all the angels who belong to the household of the Beloved of the Lights.
The ones who are called 'rich', are all the rich ones who belong to the household of the glorious Ambassador.
